renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (0x0000744C) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

protectedIcon.comparison: HQ raw vs HQ final; SBMS is excluded

performanceNote: Timer extension availability only. No timed GPU pass or production FPS claim.
metricNotes: Luma bounds come from each same-DPI source row, never another DPI capture. Values outside those bounds by more than 1 LSB measure ringing without a visual-quality assertion.
Ink is the sum of absolute luma difference from the row background; its percentage change describes weight, not sharpness.
All measured glyph rows are inside complete copied-edge tiles. Browser texture repeat is not production D3D clamp; these measurements are not native D3D bit-for-bit validation.
